brief:
An Israeli retired general has emerged as an unexpected supporter of Palestinians facing military operations in the occupied West Bank, Al-Monitor reported. The development marks a rare instance of Israeli security establishment figures publicly opposing tactics deployed against Palestinians.

The general's backing comes as Israeli soldiers, operating with covered faces and unmarked uniforms, have conducted operations in West Bank areas. The circumstances surrounding these deployments and the retired officer's specific objections remain central to the emerging dispute within Israeli security circles.
dek: The four Israeli soldiers stepped out of their car in the occupied West Bank, their faces masked, their uniforms unmarked and automatic weapons strapped across their shoulders.
title: Israeli retired general backs Palestinians under attack
